statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); folder=$(basename "$cwd"); branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); dirty=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); used_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then if [ -n "$dirty" ]; then printf "\033[32m\xE2\x9E\x9C\033[0m  \033[36m%s\033[0m \033[31mgit:(%s) \xE2\x9C\x97\033[0m" "$folder" "$branch"; else printf "\033[32m\xE2\x9E\x9C\033[0m  \033[36m%s\033[0m \033[31mgit:(%s)\033[0m" "$folder" "$branch"; fi; else printf "\033[32m\xE2\x9E\x9C\033[0m  \033[36m%s\033[0m" "$folder"; fi; [ -n "$model" ] && printf " \033[35m%s\033[0m" "$model"; [ -n "$used_pct" ] && printf " \033[33mctx:%s%%\033[0m" "$(printf '%.0f' "$used_pct")"
